service.description: The local node's link: state (unpaired, connecting, linked, retrying, refused; notBuilt in a binary without the edge link, notStarted in one with it where no HTTP listener started it, as under moqui test), the edge node's URL, the link generation, the round trip of the last Ping on the up connection, when the link last came up, the last error, the links lost since start, and the edge node as its last Hello said, with the pinned fingerprint. nodeRole is this node's node_role; on an edge node linkFingerprint is its own link key's fingerprint.

parameter.name: linkFingerprint
parameter.description: On an edge node, the fingerprint of its own link key (edge_link_key; SHA-256 of the public key, hex), to compare with what a local node's check#EdgeNode shows; empty on any other node. The key itself is never shown.

parameter.name: mediaAddress
parameter.description: The edge node's media address, when it is a media node of this node's calls (plans/archive/Edge-Node.md §5.4, E7); empty when its media socket is off.

parameter.name: turnUrls
parameter.description: The edge node's TURN URLs; empty without TURN.

service.description: Connect to the edge node at url (https://host or https://host:port), check its web certificate by WebPKI, and answer its name, the fingerprint of its link key (edge_link_key), versions and offer, without pairing: for the operator to confirm before pair#EdgeNode. compatible is false, with message, when the link protocol versions are more than one apart.

Pair this local node with the edge node at url, using the one-use code its operator made: make this node's key, have the edge node pin it, pin the edge node's link key (refused when expectFingerprint, the fingerprint check#EdgeNode showed, is given and differs), write edge_node_url, edge_node_key and edge_node_pin to runtime/.env, and bring the link up without a restart. keyFingerprint is this node's key as the edge node pinned it.
Tell the edge node to revoke this node's key (when the link is up), close the link and remove edge_node_url, edge_node_key and edge_node_pin from runtime/.env.
On an edge node: a one-use pairing code for a local node, good for validMinutes (60 by default, at most 1440). The code is shown once; only its hash is kept (moqui.edge.EdgePairingCode).

On a node that takes links (an edge node or an all-in-one node): the paired local nodes (moqui.edge.EdgeClient) with their live links: linked (the up connection is open), down (the down connection too), the generation, the remote address, and the versions of their last Hello. While the link is not running (no HTTPS listener started it), the rows alone, none linked.

parameter.name: setup
parameter.description: What the node's last Configure set besides its host names: mailDomains, chatBridgeIds and passSites; empty before one.

parameter.name: queueMaxMegabytes
parameter.description: The pairing's own queue cap; empty for the conf's queue-max-megabytes.

service.description: On a node that takes links: a pairing's own size cap on the items waiting for it (EdgeClient.queueMaxMegabytes, plans/Edge-Node2.md §4.1), in megabytes above 0, in place of the conf's queue-max-megabytes; empty unsets it. The retention pass reads it.

On a node that takes links: what each active pairing claims (plans/Edge-Node2.md §4.10 Domains): its host names (hostList, with modeEnumId), and from its last Configure its mailDomains, xmppDomain, sipDomain (its SIP realm), chatBridgeIds and passSites, with the phoneNumbers its replicated copies have (voiceFallbacks and voiceTrunks). The first claim of each holds; get#ReplicaConflicts has the records refused for it.

parameter.name: phoneNumbersCut
parameter.description: A set had more than 10,000 copies, so phoneNumbers is not all of them.

service.description: On an edge node: revoke a local node's key and close its link; it can link again only by pairing with a new code. revoked is false when no such node is paired.
On an edge node: a Ping down a linked local node's down connection; rttMs is its round trip.
On a node that takes links: the public host names of the paired local nodes (moqui.edge.EdgeHost), of one node when pairedNodeId is given.

On a node that takes links: a public host name for an active paired local node, EdgeHostPassthrough (the default) or EdgeHostTerminate; for a name the node has already, its mode changes. The name is saved in lower case with no port; a name another pairing has is refused with "another node has this name" (the first claim holds). The edge node uses it at once.
On a node that takes links: remove a public host name; the edge node stops answering for it at once. removed is false when there was no such name.

On an edge node: the TCP ports whose connections go down one paired local node's link each (moqui.edge.EdgePort, plans/Edge-Node2.md §4.10 Ports), of one node with pairedNodeId. Each has port, pairedNodeId, tunnelKind (ssh, xmpp or xmpps), listening, and errorText when it does not listen.

On an edge node: a TCP port whose connections go down an active paired local node's link, to its SSH server (tunnelKind ssh) or its XMPP server (xmpp for STARTTLS, xmpps for direct TLS). A port of this node's own listeners (its conf's tunnel ports included), and one another row has, are refused; the same row again is no change. The edge node listens on it within seconds (get#EdgePorts tells how it went).
On an edge node: remove a tunnel port; the edge node stops listening on it within seconds, and its connections open now end. removed is false when there was no such port.

Queue an item for the other end of the link (moqui.edge.EdgeQueueItem): on an edge node for its local node (pairedNodeId, or the only one paired), on a local node for its edge node. It is delivered once the link is up, in order with the other items of its conversationKey, and applied on the receiver once, by the service its edge queue-kind conf names for kind, in the transaction of its receipt. An idempotencyKey queued already returns that item (created false); with none the item's id is its key. The payload is text (JSON) of at most 1 MiB; contentLocation names a larger body (a dbresource:// file, up to 64 MiB), copied into the item here and sent over the link before it, and its handler gets where the receiver kept it.

The link's queue on this node, by paired node, direction and kind: items waiting, failed, and when the oldest waiting one was queued (of one node with pairedNodeId); whether this node's delivery is paused; on a local node its replicated sets (epoch, last batch acknowledged, changes waiting, whether a full send is due), and on an edge node the cursor of each node's set with its count of records.

Pause this node's queue delivery (paused true, the default) or resume it: while paused, every delivery from the other end is answered "paused" (it is tried again, and not counted as an attempt) and this node's own items wait. Kept in memory: a restart resumes.

On a local node: send every replicated set to the edge node whole again, under a new epoch; the edge node then removes what the full send did not have. On an edge node: forget the cursors (of one node with pairedNodeId), so each node's next batch asks for its set whole. sets is how many.

On an edge node: the copies of a local node's replicated set (moqui.edge.EdgeReplicaValue), of one entity with entityName, of one record with entityName and pk (its key fields), of one node with pairedNodeId; at most limit. Each has its entity, its key and the set's fields of it.

On an all-in-one node: whether a paired node's replica holds an item of the server's own, and then an error naming the item and the node (none with refuse false). The item is a record (itemType EmailAccount or EmailIdentity, read here: the address of a hosted or shared account; ChatBridge or PhoneNumber, by itemId), or claimKind (MailAddress, ChatBridge, PhoneNumber, XmppDomain, SipDomain, HostName) and itemKey. The server's create and update services run it after they write (EdgeClaims.secas.xml), so their transaction rolls back. Nothing on another node.

On a node that takes links: the records of the paired nodes' replicated sets not applied because each claims an item another owner holds, the server's own on an all-in-one node or another pairing's (plans/Edge-Node2.md §4.1, the first claim holds) (moqui.edge.EdgeReplicaConflict), of one node with pairedNodeId: the set, the entity, the item (claimKind, claimLabel, itemKey), the holder (ownerText: "the server's EmailAccount 100010", "paired node local-a"), and when it was first and last refused.

On a node that takes links: check the replication conflicts (of one node with pairedNodeId) again, and apply each record whose item no other owner (the server, another pairing) holds any more. Each batch of a set also does this for the set. applied is how many; 0 on a local node.

On a paired local node: what its edge node offers it now, asked on the link. offer has publicNames and hostModes (web access), mail (available, mta moqui or postfix, listener, mxHost, bounceDomain, dkimSelector, dkimRecord), chat (webhooks, publicUrl), pass (available, clientId), xmpp (available, port and tlsPort, this node's own tunnel ports or those of every XMPP domain, 0 while off, and needsNode, when this node named no XMPP domain in Configure and is not the only one linked, so the ports of every domain cannot find it), calls (available while its media node runs, mediaAddress, turnUrls, and enabled, this node's own edge_calls_enabled), sip (available while its SIP engine runs, sipAddress and tlsAddress, domain, the realm this node's phones register in there (its Configure's sipDomain when it named one), registrar, trunks, the trunks its engine loaded from this node's copy with voiceTrunkId, name, state and error, fallbacks, the numbers with a fallback in its copy, and enabled, this node's own edge_sip_enabled); otherNode and otherNodes are no longer set, notAvailable (areas not built yet: none now), addresses (the edge node's public addresses, when it names them) and nodeHosts (this node's host names there now). edgeUrl is edge_node_url. Fails while the link is down.

On a paired local node, the wizard's Apply. The whole setup is checked first (the host names, mail domains, ids and the PASS callback); when any is not input nothing changes. Then the edge node's part goes (Link.Configure); when it is not taken nothing changes on this node either. Then the local rows and settings of each area turned on are written, and every replicated set is sent whole again. Mail: an EmailServer EDGE with smtpHost edge:, SYSTEM's smtpHost edge: when systemMail, and each of emailAccountIds (hosted or shared, with no incoming server of another provider) sending through the edge node; the host or server each replaced is kept (edgePriorSmtpHost, edgePriorServerId) and put back when the node unpairs. Chat: channels_public_url in runtime/.env, the edge node's address. PASS: pass_edge_client and pass_client_(id)_sites and _callback in runtime/.env. Web: hostList (hostName, modeEnumId) is this node's whole list of names on the edge node; a name another node holds is refused there. XMPP (xmppOn): this node's xmpp_domain goes to the edge node (kept in its setupJson), and with web access on it is added to hostList as passthrough when not listed, as uploads (https://domain) and /xmpp-websocket ride on web access; with web access off and the name not on the edge node, a failed xmpp line says so and the rest is applied. Refused before any change when this node has no xmpp_domain or the edge node no tunnel port. Nothing is written locally for XMPP; lines say when this node's xmpp_port or xmpp_tls_port (which Chat apps shows) differ from the edge node's ports, and when the edge node's ports cannot find this node's clients. Calls (callsOn given, and the edge node's media node offered; left out, nothing changes; nothing is sent to the edge node): edge_calls_enabled true or false in runtime/.env, and the edge node's CallMediaNode row written again at once, draining while it is false (the link keeps it so after that, and never after unpairing), so new calls have their media on the edge node, or on this node's own media nodes while calls on the edge node go on (a failed line when it has none live, as no new call can start then); lines check the media address (public), the TURN secret the link's Hello handed this node, and the row (live, preferred). Phones (sipOn given, and the edge node's SIP engine offered; left out, nothing changes; nothing is sent to the edge node): edge_sip_enabled true or false in runtime/.env; while it is false the replicated sets voiceTrunks and voiceFallbacks go to the edge node empty, so its engine has no trunks and no fallback, and the edge node's link-kept SipNode row stays but takes no new call, and its registrar signs no phone in; lines give the two sets' replication (cursor, keys waiting), the row (live, with the Hello's addresses), the realm phones made here get (the edge node's) and those made for another, the registrar, and the numbers with and without a fallback (480 while this node is away). An area turned off is left as it is. Each step is a line of lineList (area, ok, text); one that fails does not stop the others. Refused on an edge node; fails before any change when the edge node's offer cannot be read.

parameter.name: callsOn
parameter.description: Calls on or off; left out (as Discover does when it offered no calls) leaves edge_calls_enabled as it is

parameter.name: sipOn
parameter.description: Phones on or off; left out (as Discover does when it offered no SIP engine) leaves edge_sip_enabled as it is

service.description: The DNS records a local node behind an edge node needs, each looked up now: for each of domains, MX naming mxHost, SPF that lets the edge node send (mx once the MX names it, a:mxHost, include:mxHost, which needs mxHost's own SPF record, or a network with one of its addresses), the DKIM key at (dkimSelector)._domainkey.(domain) matching dkimRecord, and DMARC; for each of hostNames, A and AAAA naming the edge node's addresses (edgeAddresses, else those of mxHost; a family the edge node lists no address of is not checked); for xmppDomain, _xmpp-client._tcp (with xmppPort) and _xmpps-client._tcp (with xmppTlsPort), each record naming one of xmppHosts (the edge node's names, the first the one to set) and that port; a port of 0 is off and its record not listed; for each of turnHosts that is a name and not one of hostNames, A and AAAA naming edgeAddresses or the address of mediaAddress (noted TURN for calls); for sipDomain (the edge node's SIP realm, when it is a DNS name), _sips._tcp (with sipTlsPort) and _sip._udp and _sip._tcp (with sipPort), each record naming one of sipHosts (the edge node's names) and that port; a port of 0 is off and its records not listed. recordList has kind, name, expected, found, ok and a note; _xmpp-server._tcp (federation, C3b) is listed as later. In a build without the mail client's resolver (the imap feature) it fails, saying so.

parameter.name: mailMta
parameter.description: The edge node's MTA, moqui or postfix: with postfix Rspamd's key signs, which the edge node does not know, so only that a DKIM record is there is checked

parameter.name: xmppDomain
parameter.description: This node's xmpp_domain when its clients come through the edge node; empty for no XMPP records

parameter.name: turnHosts
parameter.description: The hosts of the edge node's TURN URLs, when calls go through it

parameter.name: mediaAddress
parameter.description: The edge node's media address (ip:port), which its TURN host names by default

parameter.name: sipDomain
parameter.description: The edge node's SIP realm (its sip_domain) when phones go through it; empty for no SIP records

parameter.name: sipPort
parameter.description: The port of its SIP address for UDP and TCP; 0 when off

parameter.name: sipTlsPort
parameter.description: The port of its SIP address for TLS; 0 when off

service.description: On a paired local node, the wizard's Test: the link is up; with mailOn, a round trip on the queue in which the edge node checks that it takes mail for mailAddress (else a hosted or shared account's; not checked when there is none; the answer comes back as inbound mail does), and one in which it takes this node's mail and can send it (its DKIM key with the MTA in moqui, its Postfix relay answering), with the EDGE server, SYSTEM's (with systemMail) and the servers of emailAccountIds on edge:; with chatOn, one in which it checks that it takes the webhooks of chatBridgeIds (not checked with none); with passOn, the PASS client settings name passSites and the edge node has mr-pass; with xmppOn, a client stream through each tunnel port the edge node has on (check xmpp for STARTTLS, xmpps for direct TLS; not checked when off) reaches this node's XMPP server, which must take tunneled connections of that kind, and xmpp_domain is one of this node's host names there (xmppWeb); the TLS must present this node's own certificate for the domain; with callsOn (not checked while edge_calls_enabled is false), the edge node's CallMediaNode row is kept by the link, live, with the Hello's media address and not draining, so Calls.js puts it first (callsNode), make#IceServers gives a probe leg the edge node's TURN URLs with a credential signed with the secret its link handed this node (iceServers), and that credential allocates on its TURN over UDP with a permission for the IP of its media address (a TURN permission is for an IP alone), then the allocation is deleted (turn, up to 3 seconds; not checked without TURN or a UDP listener); with sipOn (not checked while edge_sip_enabled is false), the edge node's SipNode row is kept by the link, live, with the Hello's addresses (sipNode), its engine has loaded every enabled trunk of this node, none failed (sipTrunks; not checked with none), and its copy has every number's fallback, with nothing waiting to replicate (sipFallbacks). No SIP request is sent: the edge node's engine answers OPTIONS from its trunks only. No outside mail or provider is needed; the round trips' answers are waited for up to 10 seconds, and the XMPP checks (up to 3 seconds for the offer and 5 for each port) run alongside. testList has check, label, ok, checked and message; passed is true when none failed.

The queue kind edgeEcho, a round trip of the wizard's Test step (test#EdgeSetup): on an edge node the check the payload asks of the local node's copies and its own settings, answered back on the queue; on a local node the answer, kept for the test that waits for it. Granted to _EDGE_.

A delegated call's echo: on the local node it answers its message, the user it ran as (_edge_ for a delegated call) and the caller the edge node named. List it in edge delegate on both nodes to use it.
